text: AGENTS.md refers to assets/executor/setup.sh, but the deployed source is assets/executor/setup.ts; the path should be kept in sync to avoid dead-end inspection.

Following the nested shiftshift flake's nixpkgs from nixfiles changed fetchPnpmDeps behavior and invalidated its pinned frontend hash; nested source flakes need to retain their compatible nixpkgs pin unless their fixed-output hashes are refreshed.
The all-pins updater can stall inside nix-update while prefetching a release source hash (CodexBar hung in nix-build with no progress), leaving earlier package version edits partially applied.
nixfiles-check's secret regression suite expects older secret CLI help and env-diff output, so the repository check fails despite the flake evaluating and building successfully
